model: Samba standalone file server with knfsd export table on Debian 12

capture.command: apt-get install samba nfs-kernel-server openssh-server sudo; Debian default smb.conf plus shares [finance] (valid users = @finance svc-backup, read only = no), [public] (guest ok = yes, read only = yes), [archive] (available = no); /etc/exports with /srv/nfs/home (192.168.112.0/20 and lab-app01, rw) and /srv/nfs/backup (lab-backup01, ro,no_root_squash); exportfs -ra; sudoers lets user 'openmap' run /usr/sbin/exportfs. The real nas collector binary (apps/collectors/cmd/nas, options mode=linux, password credential, trustOnFirstUse) ran nas.LinuxScript over SSH against 127.0.0.1:<published sshd port>; the raw stdout it stored as cli_transcript evidence is copied here byte-for-byte (exportfs -v answered through sudo -n).

files.name: transcript.txt
files.description: Raw stdout of nas.LinuxScript: @@OPENMAP:samba@@ testparm -s dump and @@OPENMAP:nfs@@ exportfs -v table (with the wrapped-line form)
